# anatomy geometry kit (vendored)

From github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy (commit e6600ff, MIT, see LICENSE): the maths half of a skill that draws detailed
isometric machine figures. We keep only the geometry, which returns SVG path strings, and paint it on our canvas.

- `src/iso-kit.mjs`: the camera (`iso`, `depthOf`), slabs, cylinders, extrusions with 4 side shades, knurls, coils, ticks.
- `src/lathe.mjs`: turned parts on any axis (`solidOf`, `disc`, `ringBand`, `lathe`), spheres, prisms, ribs, spokes, arcs, fillets.
- `src/tube.mjs`: pipes and cables (`tubePieces`).
- `anatomy.js`: the bundle the build includes (`AN_ISO`, `AN_LATHE`, `AN_TUBE`). It is generated by
  `node studio/tools/anatomy-bundle.mjs`; never edit it directly. The SVG/HTML writers are left out.

Not taken: the interactive pages (driven by the pointer), the WebGL and 3D turn modes, the audit tools.
Use it through `studio/library/machines.js` (`AN`, `anCam`, `anPal`, `anPaint`, `anTube`, `anLine`, `anDraw`);
the demo is `studio/demos/machine`.
